guardrails.name: Refund share
guardrails.denominator: Verified purchases from the page cohort

guardrails.name: Cash cost per qualified scan
guardrails.denominator: Qualified scans from the page cohort

cards.stop_rule: Stop when the $500.00 cap is spent or after 14 days. Stop early if any verified payment from this cohort stays undelivered for more than 24 hours, or if the refund share rises above 25% (1/4). If fewer than 20 first opens are reached (budget reach: ≈7 first opens at $66.67 cash each), report the result as inconclusive and make no rate claims.
cards.continue_rule: Roll the page out to all ASA traffic only if, with at least 20 first opens, qualified scans per impression beat the default page over the same period, qualified scan ÷ first open is at or above 78% (14/18), and no guardrail is breached.
